Who We Are

About Dream Wedding Photography

Welcome to Dream Wedding Photography, where every special moment is captured with creativity, care, and professionalism.

We provide professional wedding photography, DSLR photography, videography, drone photography, and complete photo & video shooting services for weddings, parties, celebrations, and special events.

Our goal is to capture your precious moments naturally and beautifully so that you can remember them for years to come. From the first smile to the most memorable moments of your celebration, we focus on every important detail.

Our Proprietors: Sandeep Kumar Gupta & Vicky Kumar

We are committed to providing reliable service, quality photography, and a professional experience for every customer. We believe that every event has its own story — our team focuses on capturing genuine emotions, beautiful moments, and memorable experiences.

"Your moments. Your memories. Our passion."
